bodyAsJson.subject: Case Reference Number {{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.caseReferenceNumber'}} – General Order (consent)
bodyAsJson.html:
Reference no: {{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.caseReferenceNumber'}}

Your Ref: {{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.solicitorReferenceNumber'}}

{{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.applicantName'}} vs {{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.respondentName'}}

Dear {{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.name'}},

The Court has made a General Order in response to the Consent process lodged on this case.

You can view this Order on the “Consent Order Process” tab.

Sign in to your account to continue.

https://manage-case.platform.hmcts.net/

What happens next

To respond to this Order and upload a document please use the “Respond to Consent Order” event.

Help us improve this service

This is a new service which is still being developed. If you haven’t already, please tell us what you think of it and how it can be improved at http://www.smartsurvey.co.uk/s/KCECE/.

If you need help

You can contact the court if you need help.

Financial Remedies Court: {{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.courtName'}}
Email: {{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.courtEmail'}}
HM Courts & Tribunals Service

This is an automated message, please don’t reply to this email.
